decisionSummary: Select canonical dev-publish 2c31287 for Teleport 1.3.9/v15: fix the live-proven premature queued-frame cancellation, preserve asynchronous acknowledgements, bounded deadlines and sticky stream errors. Keep existing F11 bounded history refusal and the same two app actions. Main and historical refs remain preserved; no live success is asserted here.

checks: Clean source equals canonical origin/dev-publish; main remains a943d5a5.
